title: Nikla tha janaza jo ghar lot ke aaya hai
body:
Nikla tha janaza jo ghar lot ke aaya hai x4
Kis kis tarha se aal ko x2 Ummat ne sataya hai
Hai zeher ne tukde kiye shabbar ke jigar ke x2
Hai teeron ka badal to taboot pe chaya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai fatehe khaibar ko le aaye bana qaidi x2
Hai binte muhammed par darwaza giraya hai x2
Karbal main mera bhai be akber o asgher jab x2
Qurban karna qasim farwa ko bataya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula hasan ke choom ke lab kahte the ahmed x2
Haye in laboon se jigar-e-hasan tasht main aaya hai x2
"Najfi" tu sina kobi kar aur ashq baha bhi x2
tabut e hasan momino ke halke me aaya hai x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Barsaat me teero ki taboot jo aya x2times
Ghazi ki jalalat ne kohram machaya hai
Dilwaya zaher teer bhi mayyat pe chalaye
Khudh saaz khalifa ne muayede ko bulaya hai
